knowledge:
- key_parameters: genome=A named DNAStringSet or a path to a FASTA file. Defaults to hg19 (requires BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19) ;; output=Directory path to write output files (CSV and FASTA). Set to NA to avoid writing to disk ;; dels, ins, invs, dups, trans=Number of deletions, insertions, inversions, tandem duplications, and translocations to simulate ;; sizeDels, sizeIns, sizeInvs, sizeDups=Sizes of the respective SVs (single value or vector) ;; repeatBias=Logical; if TRUE, simulates bias of breakpoint positioning towards repeat regions (hg19 only) ;; bpFlankSize, percSNPs, indelProb, maxIndelSize=Parameters to configure additional breakpoint mutations (SNPs and indels) close to the breakpoint ;; regionsDels, regionsIns, regionsInvs, regionsDups, regionsTrans=GRanges objects restricting SVs to specific genomic regions ;; random=Logical (or vector); if FALSE, inserts SVs at exact coordinates specified in the regions parameters ;; tol=Tolerance in bp when comparing query SVs to simulated SVs in compareSV
- alternatives: ART or pIRS can be used downstream of RSVSim to simulate NGS reads from the rearranged FASTA file produced by RSVSim
- when_to_use: Appropriate when designing sequencing experiments, assessing the performance (sensitivity and precision) of SV detection algorithms, or generating ground-truth rearranged genomes for NGS read simulation
- pitfalls: Setting repeatBias = TRUE with a genome other than hg19 will automatically turn the feature off ;; The initial automatic download of repeat coordinates for hg19 from UCSC can take up to 45 minutes (providing a local RepeatMasker file is much quicker) ;; When inserting known SVs (random = FALSE), it is strongly recommended to use a set of non-overlapping SVs ;; compareSV only compares one SV type at a time; query and simulation tables must not contain a mixture of different SV types ;; Chromosome names in the regions GRanges must exactly match the names in the genome DNAStringSet

workflows.name: structural_variation_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate random structural variations in a genome with optional repeat biases, breakpoint mutations, or within specific genomic regions.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the genome sequence as a DNAStringSet ;; 2. Run simulateSV with specified SV counts, sizes, and optional parameters (e.g., repeatBias, bpFlankSize, regionsDels) ;; 3. Retrieve rearranged sequences and metadata
workflows.code:
genome = DNAStringSet(
c("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAATTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT", 
"GGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC"))
names(genome) = c("chr1","chr2")
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, dels=3, sizeDels=10,
bpSeqSize=6, seed=456, verbose=FALSE)
sim
metadata(sim)
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, dels=1, sizeDels=5, bpFlankSize=10, 
percSNPs=0.25, indelProb=1, maxIndelSize=3, bpSeqSize=10, seed=123, verbose=FALSE)
regions = GRanges(IRanges(c(21,1),c(40,20)), seqnames=c("chr1","chr2"))
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, invs=4, sizeInvs=5, 
regionsInvs=regions, bpSeqSize=6, seed=2345, verbose=FALSE)

workflows.name: inserting_known_svs
workflows.intent: Insert a set of known, user-defined structural variations at exact coordinates.
workflows.stages: 1. Define the exact coordinates of the SVs using GRanges ;; 2. Run simulateSV with random=FALSE and pass the GRanges to the corresponding regions parameter
workflows.code:
knownDeletion = GRanges(IRanges(16,25), seqnames="chr2")
names(knownDeletion) = "myDeletion"
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, regionsDels=knownDeletion,
bpSeqSize=10, random=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
knownInsertion = GRanges(IRanges(16,25),seqnames="chr1", chrB="chr2", startB=26)
names(knownInsertion) = "myInsertion"
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, regionsIns=knownInsertion,
bpSeqSize=10, random=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)

workflows.name: comparing_sv_sets
workflows.intent: Compare simulated ground-truth SVs with query SVs detected by an algorithm to evaluate performance.
input: detected_svs.bed (detected SV coordinates from an SV caller)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract simulated SVs from the simulation metadata ;; 2. Format or load the query SVs as a data.frame ;; 3. Run compareSV with a specified tolerance
workflows.code:
sim = simulateSV(output=NA, genome=genome, dels=5, sizeDels=5,
bpSeqSize=10, seed=2345, verbose=FALSE)
simSVs = metadata(sim)$deletions
querySVs = data.frame(
  chr=c("chr1","chr1","chr1","chr2","chr2"),
  start=c(12,17,32,2,16), 
  end=c(15,24,36,6,20), 
  bpSeq=c("AAAAAAAAAA", "AAAAAAATTT", "TTTTTTTTTT", 
    "GGGGGGGGGG", "GGGGGGCCCC")
)
compareSV(querySVs, simSVs, tol=0)
compareSV(querySVs, simSVs, tol=3)

workflows.name: estimating_sv_sizes
workflows.intent: Estimate and generate realistic SV size distributions by fitting a beta distribution to real data or using default database parameters.
input: real_sv_sizes.txt (optional list of real SV sizes to fit)
workflows.stages: 1. Define a vector of real SV sizes or select a default SV type ;; 2. Run estimateSVSizes to generate a vector of simulated sizes
workflows.code:
svSizes = c(10,20,30,40,60,80,100,150,200,250,300,400,500,750,1000)
simSizes = estimateSVSizes(n=1000, svSizes=svSizes, minSize=10, maxSize=1000, hist=TRUE) 
delSizes = estimateSVSizes(n=10000, minSize=500, maxSize=10000, 
default="deletions", hist=TRUE)
